_note: Units a researcher has already worked and found nothing for, per field. Not a claim that nothing exists -- a record that a search was made and came back empty, so the next worklist does not spend an agent on it again. `gaps.js` excludes these from the worklists it builds; they still count as MISSING in the coverage figures, because they are. Remove an entry when a new source appears that the earlier search could not have seen.
